abilities.name: Secret Spear of Wangsheng

sections.title: Normal Attack
sections.description: Performs up to 6 consecutive spear strikes.

sections.title: Charged Attack
sections.description: Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to lunge forward, dealing damage to opponents along the way.

sections.title: Plunging Attack
sections.description: Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

abilities.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 6 consecutive spear strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to lunge forward, dealing damage to opponents along the way.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
_curatorNotes: N5 has two hitmarks (16, 26); swap reflects the last hitmark per recipe convention.
N6 C-cancel is illegal in gcsim (ActionCharge = 500 with TODO comment); omitted.
Base charged-attack hitmark = 19 (gcsim). High plunge variants exist in gcsim but are not represented per recipe.
gcsim restricts plunge to AirborneXianyun-launched only — this is a sim limitation, not an in-game one. plungeFrames sourced from gcsim's lowPlungeFrames; in-game any post-jump plunge works.

abilities.name: Secret Spear of Wangsheng (Paramita Papilio)
abilities.caveat: Charged-attack cancel timing into dash or jump varies with the preceding normal; the timing shown is for a standalone charged attack.
abilities.description: Hu Tao's normal-attack combo while in the Paramita Papilio stance. The 6-hit string and base frame timings match the standard combo, but all hits are converted to Pyro DMG and benefit from Paramita Papilio's flat ATK bonus.
_curatorNotes: Frame deltas vs base normal: N5 N-cancel 36 (vs 37); N6 swap 27 (vs 23). PP chargeFrames hitmark = 3 (vs 19 base).

Plunge frames sourced from gcsim's lowPlungeFramesB (Paramita variant). gcsim does not set ActionDash or ActionJump on lowPlungeFramesB — D and J omitted per recipe rule. Plunges deal Pyro DMG with IgnoreInfusion in gcsim.
[A7] Charged-attack dash/jump cancel windows are position-dependent: N1→D=1, N2→D=4, N3–N5→D=2–3 frames; the authored chargeFrames reflect a standalone CA cast.

abilities.name: Guide to Afterlife
abilities.caveat: Not modeled: the 30% current-HP drain on cast.
_curatorNotes: PP flat-ATK conversion: ratio 5.957 reflects ppatk[8] (talent 9 baseline). Per-talent table from gcsim hutao_gen.go: TL1–15 = 3.841 / 4.071 / 4.301 / 4.600 / 4.830 / 5.060 / 5.359 / 5.658 / 5.957 / 6.256 / 6.555 / 6.854 / 7.153 / 7.452 / 7.751.

Buff is capped at 400% of Hu Tao's BaseATK (gcsim: maxBonus = BaseATK * 4). Schema's scaling.cap is a fixed number; the cap here is caster-relative and not authored. Reviewer to model the cap once schema supports relative caps.

snapshottable: false chosen to match the Sanguine Rouge passive convention in this file. The buff value is computed once at cast and cached, but the field semantics in this codebase are 'does the buff freeze onto outgoing attacks at attack time' — verify this is the right reading for PP.

abilities.name: Spirit Soother
abilities.caveat: DMG and heal are boosted at ≤50% HP (not modeled).
_curatorNotes: Heal procs once per enemy hit by the burst, capped at 5 procs per cast (gcsim burstHealCount). Schema has no proc-cap-per-cast field; reviewer may add procCooldown or similar if needed.

Low-HP variant (≤50% HP at cast time): mult swaps to burstLow[talent] and heal swaps to regenLow[talent]. regenLow[8] = 10.5%. Not modeled as a separate variant; reviewer to decide whether a state-conditioned variant is warranted.
Spirit Soother does NOT end Paramita Papilio (gcsim onExitField only fires on swap; burst.go has no DeleteStatMod for paramita). PP and Q can run concurrently.

passives.name: Flutter By
passives.description: When a Paramita Papilio state activated by Guide to Afterlife ends, all allies in the party (excluding Hu Tao herself) will have their CRIT Rate increased by 12% for 8s.

passives.name: Sanguine Rouge
passives.description: When Hu Tao's HP is equal to or less than 50%, her Pyro DMG Bonus is increased by 33%.

constellations.name: Crimson Bouquet
constellations.description: While in a Paramita Papilio state activated by Guide to Afterlife, Hu Tao's Charged Attacks do not consume Stamina.
_curatorNotes: No effect authored: stamina-cost reduction has no representation in the effect schema. gcsim implements via ActionStam override returning 0 when paramitaBuff is active and Cons >= 1. Practical impact in the planner is zero — stamina is not modeled.

constellations.name: Ominous Rainfall
constellations.description:
Increases the Blood Blossom DMG by an amount equal to 10% of Hu Tao's Max HP at the time the effect is applied.
Additionally, Spirit Soother will also apply the Blood Blossom effect.
_curatorNotes: No effects authored. Two parts: (a) Blood Blossom ticks gain FlatDmg += MaxHP * 0.10 (gcsim skill.go bbtickfunc, gated on Cons >= 2); (b) Spirit Soother applies Blood Blossom on hit (gcsim burst.go: bbcb = c.applyBB when Cons >= 2). Blood Blossom itself is not authored as a primary damage effect anywhere in this file — it's a sub-effect of the charged attack hit during PP. Reviewer to decide BB representation, then wire C2's flat-DMG add and Q-application as modifiers.

constellations.name: Lingering Carmine
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Guide to Afterlife by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Garden of Eternal Rest
constellations.description: Upon defeating an enemy affected by a Blood Blossom that Hu Tao applied herself, all nearby allies in the party (excluding Hu Tao herself) will have their CRIT Rate increased by 12% for 15s.
constellations.caveat: The +12% CRIT Rate buff for her other party members fires when an enemy marked by her Blood Blossom dies. Enemy death isn't simulated, so it's a manual window — toggle it on when it applies.
_curatorNotes: Stub-with-caveat (decided 2026-05-14, onTargetDied category): manual trigger preserved because enemy-death state is null-resolving in the planner (no enemy HP/death simulation). gcsim event is OnTargetDied filtered to enemies carrying Hu Tao's bbDebuff status. Re-evaluate if a death-tracking primitive ever lands. Duration / target / value are correct.

constellations.name: Floral Incense
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Spirit Soother by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Butterfly's Embrace
constellations.description:
Triggers when Hu Tao's HP drops below 25%, or when she suffers a lethal strike:
Hu Tao will not fall as a result of the DMG sustained. Additionally, for the next 10s, her All Elemental and Physical RES is increased by 200%, her CRIT Rate is increased by 100%, and her resistance to interruption is greatly increased.
This effect triggers automatically when Hu Tao has 1 HP left.
Can only occur once every 60s.
_curatorNotes: No effects authored. C6 has three components, none cleanly authorable today: (a) revive — no schema concept; (b) +200% allElementalRes + physicalRes — stats now exist (added 2026-05-09) but the effect is gated on the OnPlayerHPDrain event with hpBelow25 state, neither of which the schema models; (c) +100% CR for 10s, same trigger gap. gcsim subscribes to OnPlayerHPDrain plus a 2-frame periodic check, gated on hpRatio <= 0.25 and 60s c6ICDKey. Effects remain unauthored until the trigger primitive lands.
